mechanics.claim: Encore fires from Seraphine's location at the end of the initial cast time, so damage lands after the 0.5s cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Encore'' fires from '''Seraphine's''' location at the end of the initial cast time.

mechanics.claim: The slow starts at 40% and increases by 15% every 0.25 seconds up to 99%, but this does not affect the dummy or survival damage.
mechanics.quote: slows them by 40% for a duration, increasing by 15% every {{fd|0.25}} seconds over the duration up to 99%

mechanics.claim: Encore has a second cast time acting only as a lockout on Seraphine after the wave is fired, not affecting when the damage lands.
mechanics.quote: ''Encore'' has two cast times. Both last {{fd|0.5}} seconds. The wave will always project after the first cast time, and the second cast time only serves as a {{tip|lockout|lock out}} for '''Seraphine'''.

mechanics.claim: The projectile's travel distance resets on hitting a champion, letting it hit additional targets without a separate damage roll being specified beyond the single hit tooltip.
mechanics.quote: ''Encore's'' projectile resets its remaining travel distance whenever it hits an allied or enemy {{tip|champion}}, excluding '''Seraphine'''.

mechanics.claim: If negated by a spell shield, the projectile is blocked and does not reset its travel distance (relevant for damage-fight negation).
mechanics.quote: If ''Encore's'' projectile is negated via {{tip|spell shield}}, this will also prevent it from resetting its travel distance.
